facts.text: Deborah received a letter from her mother, which she received yesterday, and it was written on a piece of paper.

evidence.quote: Look what letter I received yesterday! [image: a photo of a note written to someone on a piece of paper]

facts.text: Deborah mentioned that she goes to her old home, which is where she feels connected to her mother, and she sits by the window there.

evidence.quote: That's my old home. I go there now and then for my mom, who passed away. Sitting in that spot by the window gives me peace.

facts.text: Deborah shared that the group members sent her a message thanking her for the positive influence she had on them, which reminded her of her passion for yoga.

evidence.quote: The group members sent this to me! They thanked me for the positive influence I had on them. Those moments remind me why I'm so passionate about yoga.

facts.text: Deborah indicated that one of the places where she does yoga is in a living room with a television and a window, as shown in a photo.

evidence.quote: This is one of the places where I do it. [image: a photo of a living room with a television and a window]
